items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: see we worked together with Raymond Scott, too.

ctx.x: But he used to -- well, all right, I know he got drunk, I guess I don't know how much he drank.

Of course that's the reason he would get -- see we worked together with Raymond Scott, too. Raymond Scott, let's see Charlie Shoverers, Benny Morton, trombone player out of the old Benny-Mo ten Band, and Ben Webster, Specks Powell and myself.

Now when we would have, when we were allowed as much rehearsal time as the show was, right because a half an hour show, we'd have a half an hour rehearsal. And when we'd have a break, Charlie would head straight for the bar, Ben would be right behind him. Charlie would drink, drink, drink and Ben would try to keep up with him. Ben, I mean, he couldn't find his seat. Fall down, knock over the Bandstand, knock over his music stand, his chair. (Laughter). So Raymond Scott called Ben over, he says Ben, he says, don't…
